## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2015-07-23: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.5 to S-1/A
- 2015-07-29: vTv Therapeutics Up-C IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement filed at 85% to vTv Therapeutics Holdings, LLC (subsequently succeeded by M&F TTP Holdings Two LLC, a MacAndrews & Forbes vehicle), covering Section 754 basis step-ups from future LLC Unit exchanges, imputed interest, and tax benefits attributable to TRA payments themselves (8-K)

#### Beneficiary exchange (no contract change)

- 2025-09-19: M&F TTP Holdings Two LLC exchanges its entire 577,108-unit LLC position for Class A common stock; the exchange creates Section 754 basis step-ups within TRA coverage but no liability is recorded due to vTv's full valuation allowance and going-concern doubt

## Explanation

vTv Therapeutics Inc. executed an 85% Up-C Tax Receivable Agreement at its July 29, 2015 IPO close, originally with vTv Therapeutics Holdings, LLC (dissolved October 2015 and succeeded by MacAndrews & Forbes-affiliated M&F TTP Holdings Two LLC), covering Section 754 basis step-ups from future LLC Unit exchanges, imputed interest, and tax benefits on TRA payments. No amendment, restatement, or termination has been filed across eleven fiscal years of post-IPO disclosures. On September 19, 2025 MacAndrews exchanged its full 577,108-unit Up-C overhang for Class A common stock, triggering basis step-ups within TRA coverage; however, vTv is clinical-stage with no product revenue, carries a full valuation allowance on its deferred tax assets, and has disclosed substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern, so no TRA liability has been recognized and no payments have been made. The contract is legally in force but economically dormant; the September 2025 exchange has crystallized the basis step-up but the corresponding deferred tax asset has zero economic value to a non-tax-paying issuer. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record and the going-concern context.
